title: Customer cohort runway and OKRs for hosted model rotation playbook
creator: Avery Chen
description: Goal: Create a repeatable, customer-cohort-driven quarterly runway for hosted API model rotations that maps directly to product OKRs and capacity contracts. This playbook will define: (1) how we prioritize model rotation windows by customer cohort (free, standard, enterprise/dedicated), (2) the set of gating metrics for model health and quality (latency P95, regression on canary eval suite, embedding similarity drift), (3) the cadence and decision triggers for canary -> staged rollout -> full rotation, and (4) communication and rollback play for downstream customers and partners. This ticket covers the PM deliverables: playbook draft, OKR alignment doc, prioritized runway schedule, and stakeholder sign-offs. Engineering will provide capacity hedges and automated evaluation hooks. Design will provide customer-facing rollout messaging templates. Success metrics: playbook accepted by Platform Leadership, roadmap schedule integrated into the roadmap calendar, and two pilot rotations executed with <1% customer error surface and zero-severity incidents.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook draft uploaded to Confluence (link included) and reviewed by Eng/Design/Sales
OKR mapping table created showing which roadmap lanes map to Q2 OKRs and what success metrics score each lane
Cohort prioritization rubric (free/standard/enterprise) finalized and signed off
Automated canary evaluation checklist defined and hooked to CI (ENG owners assigned)
Communications templates (email, status page, in-console notices) drafted and reviewed-approved by Design and Comms
Two pilot model rotations scheduled in staging and observed for one week with regression <1% on the regression suite
risks: Capacity mismatch between scheduled rotations and available Dedicated pools could force delays
Eval suite may not capture subtle quality regressions for niche enterprise prompts
Cross-team sign-off delays (Legal/Compliance) could block enterprise cohort rollouts
Customer confusion if messaging is inconsistent across Console and Billing
